title: Blue Holds the Line
description: Defenders detect anomalous edge directory enumeration, correlate initial phishing telemetry, and quarantine the endpoint before credential dumping succeeds.

detail.title: Subdomain & Mail Gateway Probe
detail.description: Adversary probes external MX records and mail gateway headers.
detail.log: mail-gw01: TLS handshake verification rate limit triggered (IP: 198.51.100.99)
detail.defenderDetect: Edge WAF / gateway rate-limiting telemetry flag unusual probing burst.

detail.title: Perimeter Threat Intelligence Flag
detail.description: SOC SIEM correlates source IP against known threat intel feed, automatically increasing inspection level.
detail.log: SIEM: Threat feed match on external CIDR. Email quarantine threshold set to aggressive.
detail.attackerMove: Adversary attempts spearphish campaign through perimeter.
detail.defenderDetect: Pre-emptive threat intel correlation on inbound mail stream.
detail.attackerAdapt: Compromise a reputable third-party vendor email domain.

detail.title: Phishing Payload Delivery
detail.description: Deceptive invoice attachment reaches staging buffer on ws-402.
detail.log: ws-402 Defender: Quarantined payload before user execution (Signature: MockHeuristics)
detail.attackerMove: Attempts invoice macro execution on user workstation.
detail.defenderDetect: Endpoint protection heuristics and Mail Gateway attachment sandbox.
detail.attackerAdapt: Encrypt archive with out-of-band password to bypass sandbox.

detail.title: SOC Triage & Indicator Extraction
detail.description: Blue analyst validates malicious macro hash and sender header inconsistencies.
detail.log: SOC-QUEUE: Ticket CASE-4401 moved from DETECTED -> TRIAGED (Confidence 98%)
detail.defenderDetect: Analyst extracts C2 domain from attachment metadata.
detail.attackerAdapt: Implement multi-stage staging server with domain fronting.

detail.title: Proactive Isolation & C2 Sinkholing
detail.description: SOC applies Proxmox SDN firewall drop rule and sinkholes adversary C2 callback domain.
detail.cmd: pve-firewall ipset add quarantined_hosts 10.0.2.42; dns_sinkhole add evil-fintechcorp.fake
detail.log: Core Router: 0 packets leaked. Attack chain broken at delivery stage.
detail.defenderDetect: Sinkhole telemetry logs connection attempt with 0 bytes transferred.
detail.attackerAdapt: Pivot to physical drop or supply chain compromise.

detail.title: Zero Breach Confirmed
detail.description: Domain controller and finance databases remain completely uncompromised.
detail.log: SOC Report: Breach neutralized. Zero lateral movement. MTTD 10s. MTTR 22s.
detail.defenderDetect: All enterprise assets intact; post-incident review logged.
detail.attackerAdapt: Regroup and prepare alternate attack vector.

decisionPoints.prompt: Phishing email intercepted with suspicious attachment for analyst@fintechcorp.local. What action should Blue SOC prioritize?

options.label: Quarantine email across all mailboxes & block payload hash in EDR
options.feedback: Flushed malicious payload from all inboxes before any user could open it.

options.label: Allow execution in monitor mode to see attacker C2 infrastructure
options.feedback: Risky live monitoring allowed adversary process to query local cached tokens.

options.label: Send an email warning to the recipient
options.feedback: Warning arrived too late after user had already downloaded the attachment.

review.lesson: Pre-emptive perimeter threat correlation and rapid endpoint hash blacklisting prevent attackers from gaining an initial foothold.
